_meta.description: The Advanced page (board PqGeavanceerdHub): one page of link cards for everything that sets the app up and the overviews read now and then, grouped as the Advanced foldout in the navigation groups them. A `links` page (CnLinkCardsPage), so it is configuration only. The library leaves out a card whose route does not resolve.

panel.label: For administrators
panel.text: Pipelinq opens with the simple menu. Extended brings every item back. Both menus open the same pages, so links and bookmarks keep working. The choice applies to everyone and therefore lives on the Nextcloud admin page, not in the app.

link.label: Change the menu structure in the admin settings

panel.title: Menu structure
panel.subtitle: This is how it is set now. Only an administrator can change it, in the admin settings.

facts.label: Menu
facts.note: Nine menu items for customer contact. Everything else is one step away, on the Modules page or in the settings.
